text: Amaterasu gave the mirror, the jewels and the sword to her grandson Ninigi, but the man who would build a country with them had not yet been born.
spoken: Amaterasu gave the mirror, the jewels and the sword to her grandson Ninigi, but the man who would build a country with them had not yet been born.
